newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady on mill buying.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates stayed steady on Monday and are likely to remain firm on Tuesday on demand from mills, dealers said.
"The mill owners from the Punjab province are buyers in Sindh (province)," dealer Kishan Chand said. "The fresh supplies have not fully picked and do not match the demand."
Dealers said it would take two weeks more before supplies from the new 1997/98 (July-June crop) increase in Sindh, while picking in Punjab would be in full swing by early September.
In the kerb market, the new-crop NIAB-78 variety was traded around 2,230 rupees ($54.89) per maund (37.32 k.g).
